spec.answerBox: Call of Duty: Mobile ikki xil versiyada mavjud: Garena (SG/MY) va Global (Activision). Ularning serverlari, akkauntlari va Player ID lari alohida — bir versiyaning ID siga to'ldirilgan CP ikkinchisiga tushmaydi. Versiyani ilova nomi va kirish usulidan aniqlang. GemPay hozircha Garena SG/MY Player ID bo'yicha to'ldiradi.

outline.covers: Garena versiyasi Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyo (jumladan SG/MY) uchun Garena tomonidan, Global esa Activision tomonidan chiqariladi. Alohida server, alohida akkaunt bazasi, alohida do'kon, alohida tadbirlar va alohida redeem kodlar. Cross-play va akkaunt ko'chirish yo'q.

1) Ilova nomi va ikonkasi: 'Call of Duty: Mobile - Garena' vs oddiy 'Call of Duty: Mobile'. 2) Android paket nomi: com.garena.game.codm vs Activision nashri. 3) Kirish usuli: Garena akkaunti taklif qilinsa — Garena; Activision akkaunti so'ralsa — Global. 4) O'yin ichidagi do'kon va tadbirlar brendi. Har biri uchun qayerga qarash kerakligini aytish.

Ustunlar: nashriyot, mintaqa/server, kirish usuli, Player ID, CP do'koni va paket ko'rinishi, redeem kodlar, to'ldirish kanallari, GemPay qo'llab-quvvatlaydimi. Garena paketlari bonus CP bilan nostandart raqamlarda (masalan 230+23 turidagi), Global paketlari esa yaxlit raqamlarda bo'lishini misol sifatida ko'rsatish — bu foydalanuvchiga versiyani do'kondan ham aniqlash imkonini beradi.

outline.h2: Player ID ikkala versiyada qayerda turadi
outline.covers: O'yin lobbisi -> yuqori o'ng burchakdagi Settings -> User Settings -> pastda Legal and Privacy yonida Player ID. Faqat raqamlar, bo'sh joysiz nusxa ko'chirish. Player ID nickname emas; nikni o'zgartirsangiz ham ID o'zgarmaydi. ID ni skrinshot qilib saqlab qo'yish tavsiyasi.

outline.h2: Nega bu to'ldirishda hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega
outline.covers: CP faqat ID kiritilgan versiya ichidagi akkauntga boradi. Noto'g'ri versiya ID si berilsa buyurtma rad etiladi yoki CP butunlay boshqa o'yinchiga tushadi va qaytarilmaydi. GemPay ayni paytda Garena SG/MY Player ID bo'yicha ishlaydi; Global akkaunt egalari avval qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan aniqlashtirishi kerak.

Rasmiy transfer mavjud emas — progress, skin va CP ko'chmaydi. 'Region o'zgartiramiz', 'Global ni Garena ga aylantiramiz' deydigan xizmatlar akkauntni bloklanish xavfiga qo'yadi. Bepul CP generatorlari ham xuddi shunday. To'g'ri yo'l: o'zingizdagi versiyaga mos to'ldirish kanalini tanlash.

outline.h2: Garena akkauntingiz bo'lsa — CP ni shu yerda to'ldiring
outline.covers: Player ID ni tayyorlab @Gempayuz_bot ga o'tish, nik bepul tekshiriladi, so'mda to'lov, CP ~3 daqiqada. To'liq qo'llanma uchun call-of-duty-mobile-cp-sotib-olish va /oyinlar/call-of-duty-mobile ga havola.

faq.q: CODM Garena va Global — bu bitta o'yinmi?
faq.a: Yo'q. O'yin mexanikasi o'xshash, lekin ular alohida nashriyot (Garena va Activision), alohida server va alohida akkaunt tizimiga ega. Ikkala versiyani telefoningizga o'rnatish mumkin, lekin bitta akkaunt bilan ikkalasida ham o'ynab bo'lmaydi.
O'yinni oching, yuqori o'ng burchakdagi Settings tugmasini bosing va User Settings bo'limiga kiring. Player ID pastda, Legal and Privacy yonida ko'rinadi. Uni ortiqcha bo'sh joysiz nusxa ko'chiring.

faq.q: Garena ID ga to'ldirilgan CP Global akkauntga tushadimi?
faq.a: Yo'q. CP faqat siz ID sini kiritgan versiyadagi akkauntga boradi. Noto'g'ri versiya ID si kiritilsa, buyurtma rad etiladi yoki CP boshqa o'yinchiga tushib ketadi.

faq.q: Akkauntni Global dan Garena ga ko'chirsa bo'ladimi?
faq.a: Yo'q, rasmiy transfer mavjud emas va progress ko'chmaydi. Bunday 'transfer' yoki 'region o'zgartirish' va'da qiladigan xizmatlar akkauntni bloklanishga olib kelishi mumkin. Xavfsiz yo'l — o'zingizdagi versiyada qolish.

Odatda Garena mintaqaviy narxlar va tez-tez bo'ladigan aksiyalar tufayli arzonroq hisoblanadi. Ammo paket hajmlari ham farq qiladi, shuning uchun taqqoslaganda asosiy CP va bonus CP ni birga hisoblang.

Yo'q. Garena kodlari Global akkauntda, Global kodlari esa Garena da xatolik beradi. Kodlar har bir versiya uchun alohida chiqariladi, shuning uchun kod olishdan oldin manbaning qaysi versiya uchun ekanini tekshiring.
GemPay Garena SG/MY Player ID bo'yicha ishlaydi va CP taxminan 3 daqiqada tushadi. Global akkaunt uchun avval @StarsPaymeeSupport bilan bog'lanib, hozirgi imkoniyatni aniqlang.

competitorResearch: VERIFIED ONLINE: (1) Garena vs Global are two fully separate games — separate publishers (Garena SEA vs Activision), servers, accounts, redeem codes and CP economies; a Garena SG/MY Player ID does NOT work for Global top-ups and vice versa (lootbar, brgeeks, seagm, elitedias). (2) Attempting to transfer/shift an account between builds is punishable by ban — confirmed in multiple community/guide sources, so the region article must WARN, not advise. (3) Player ID location confirmed twice: in-game Settings (top-right) -> User Settings -> Player ID shown at the bottom near 'Legal and Privacy'. (4) Garena SG/MY CP tiers are odd-numbered with bonus CP (114 / 230+23 / 460+69 / 690+104 / 1150+173 / 2300+460 / 4600+1840 / 6858+2744 / 11429+4572 on SEAGM) and differ from Global's round 500/1100/2400/5000 — useful proof that 'which version' changes what you buy. (5) Battle Pass ~560 CP; Lucky Draw is an escalating ladder (25/70/180/360/580/900/1400/2800/4000 CP in one Garena draw, ~10,315 CP total). (6) Codashop's own guidance: they never ask for PlayerID AND password — good trust framing. COMPETITION READ (verified): the Uzbek-language SERP for CODM top-up is effectively EMPTY. Searches in Uzbek Latin ('codm cp to'ldirish o'zbekiston', 'call of duty mobile cp sotib olish uzbekistan') return only YouTube gameplay clips and irrelevant Telegram-bot blog posts — zero commercial pages. The Russian CODM SERP is owned by .ru donate shops (donatov.net, dem-gold, coolgameservice, szmarket, kupikod, ggsel, funpay) plus Codashop KZ — none of which accept UzCard/HUMO/so'm, so 'узбекистан / сум / humo uzcard' modifiers are wide open. By contrast the Uzbek PUBG UC SERP is already contested (Midasbuy UZ, Payme blog, 1pay.uz, hablax, mtcgame, milliysavdo.store) — proof that Uzbek-language money pages DO rank here, and that CODM is the same opportunity with no incumbent. The Telegram-Premium niche (uzgets.uz, starsjoy.uz) shows the exact winning page pattern for this audience: Uzbek Latin + 'so'm' + UzCard/Humo/Click/Payme + bot. INFERRED (not verified with volume data — Ahrefs and Semrush connectors are unauthorized in this session, so there are NO real volume/KD numbers here): relative ordering of the keyword lists, the transliterated spellings ('kod mobayl', 'codm'), and the assumption that a meaningful share of Uzbek CODM players sit on the Garena SG/MY build. That last assumption is exactly why article #2 is written as an identification guide rather than a recommendation — a Global-account reader must be told the honest answer, not pushed into a purchase.
